Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, p As Object, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set p = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 100, 50, 120, 60)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    s = "|" & p.AlternativeText & "," & p.Title & "," & p.Decorative & "," & p.Rotation & "," & p.Left & "," & p.Top & "," & p.LockAspectRatio & "," & p.Locked
    Select Case which
    Case 0
    Case 1
        p.AlternativeText = "A box"
    Case 2
        p.Title = "Box title"
    Case 3
        p.AlternativeText = "Desc & <more>": p.Title = "T"
    Case 4
        p.AlternativeText = "x": p.AlternativeText = ""
    Case 5
        p.Decorative = True
    Case 6
        p.Decorative = msoTrue
    Case 7
        p.Rotation = 45
    Case 8
        p.Rotation = -30
    Case 9
        p.Rotation = 400
    Case 10
        p.Rotation = 12.5
    Case 11
        p.IncrementRotation 10: p.IncrementRotation 15
    Case 12
        p.IncrementLeft 12: p.IncrementTop -4.5
    Case 13
        p.IncrementLeft -500
    Case 14
        p.LockAspectRatio = msoTrue
    Case 15
        p.LockAspectRatio = msoTrue: p.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
    Case 16
        p.Locked = False
    Case 17
        p.Locked = False: p.Locked = True
    End Select
    Tried = "ok" & s & "|" & p.AlternativeText & "," & p.Title & "," & p.Decorative & "," & p.Rotation & "," & p.Left & "," & p.Top & "," & p.LockAspectRatio & "," & p.Locked
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & s
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 17
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
